title: The same component, in the HTML
lead: The block below still owns its lexicon, but the page loaded it. Its strings are in the server-rendered HTML, so a crawler sees them and there is nothing to wait for.

payload.title: The page does the loading
payload.text: The component exports snapshot(locale); the page's load calls it and passes the payload down as a prop.

ssr.title: Complete on the first render
ssr.text: initLocale settles the locale synchronously and the snapshot's keys count as loaded, so no loader runs to produce the first paint.

reactive.title: Still reactive
reactive.text: Switch the language and the component loads its own lexicon for the new locale, in the browser, without the page reloading.
